name: Password Sign-In MFA Required
summary: A user enters through Welcome, chooses email authentication, submits valid password credentials for a TOTP-enabled account, and is required to complete TOTP proof before an authenticated application session can be established.
finalOutcome: The password proof is accepted, no authenticated application session is issued yet, and the user is placed on the canonical TOTP continuation surface to provide the required second factor.

sourceReferences.note: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.SignInResult.RequiresTwoFactor is normalized to AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired without completing application sign-in.
A successful password result carrying AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired emits auth.transition.password-sign-in.mfa-required.
Canonical second-factor continuation surface already exists for browser and mobile TOTP proof.
Valid password plus required TOTP is modeled as a distinct Password Sign-In behavior because it does not establish the final authenticated session and requires a materially different next action.
